subject: Renewal + Isolated Enclave: accelerated provisioning and delivery playbook
messages:
From: Alicia Gomez <agomez@bluebaypharma.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Cc: BlueBay Procurement <procurement@bluebaypharma.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: Renewal + isolated enclave at renewal — timeline and ask

Hi Dylan / Monica,

Hope you’re well — our renewal for Q1 2027 is coming up and we want to expand our private footprint. The ask: add two isolated VPC-enclaves (one EU, one US) with dedicated clusters and stricter tenant isolation for regulated workloads. We need pricing guidance, an updated SOW, and an accelerated provisioning option because our go-live is targeted for 2027-02-15.

A few constraints:
- EU enclave must be air-gapped to the extent possible (no cross-region peering for data in scope).
- We require KMS integration and SOC2 evidence for the new clusters.
- Procurement prefers a single-term amendment covering expansion and renewal (three-year term preferred).

Can you confirm feasibility and a delivery playbook with milestones? I attached a redline of our updated MAA and a network sketch.

Thanks,
Alicia

Attachments: BlueBay_MAA_v2.pdf; vpc_network_diagram.png

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Gomez <agomez@bluebaypharma.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 11:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal + isolated enclave at renewal — timeline and ask

Alicia — thanks for the clear ask and the attachments. High level: yes, we can deliver two isolated VPC enclaves and provision dedicated clusters for each region within your target if we start procurement and infra sizing this month.

Immediate next steps I propose:
1) Internal alignment call (we) to map capacity / SLA commitments — I’ll loop Ben for Dedicated sizing.
2) Redwood and BlueBay agree on a one-off addendum (SOW + pricing) that folds into the renewal term. I’ll draft a playbook with milestones and a fallback plan (staged rollout).
3) Exchange SOC2 evidence and finalize KMS details via Security questionnaire itemization.

I’ll schedule a 30-min call with your team early next week. Would Mon/Tue 9am PT work?

Cheers,
Dylan

--
Dylan Brooks
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 12:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal + isolated enclave at renewal — timeline and ask

Looping in capacity / delivery notes. For two isolated enclaves with dedicated clusters (estimated 4xA100 equiv per region to hit your SLA targets at current load), lead time is ~6-8 weeks once infra config is signed off and capacity is reserved. Key dependencies: procurement commit, network peering/ASN confirmations, and KMS/HSM onboarding windows in each region.

I recommend we offer an accelerated provisioning path (premium setup fee + prioritized capacity reservation) to compress to 3-4 weeks. We’ve done this twice for customers needing a hard go-live. Will prepare a staging timeline (milestone Gantt) and pricing delta for the premium path.

Ben
Director, Deployment Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Alicia Gomez <agomez@bluebaypharma.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Cc: Peter Liu <pliu@bluebaypharma.com>, BlueBay Procurement <procurement@bluebaypharma.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 08:40:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal + isolated enclave at renewal — timeline and ask

Thanks — premium path sounds reasonable given our deadline. Procurement: we prefer a single amendment rolled into the contract renewal and can accommodate a one-time setup fee. We will need:
- a detailed milestone plan with acceptance criteria
- clear security deliverables (SOC2 evidence, KMS key ownership model)
- an itemized pricing sheet with one-time setup and monthly committed spend

Peter (cc) is our internal IT lead — he’ll confirm firewall / ASN details on the call. We are available Tue 2026-11-24 at 9am PT for the alignment call.

Alicia

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Gomez <agomez@bluebaypharma.com>, Peter Liu <pliu@bluebaypharma.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>, BlueBay Procurement <procurement@bluebaypharma.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 09:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal + isolated enclave at renewal — timeline and ask

Great — call confirmed for Tue 9am PT. Attached is an initial delivery playbook and a checklist we’ll use on the call (SOW draft, milestone Gantt, capacity sizing, security items). Ben will run through the accelerated setup delta and acceptance criteria. Monica will drive contract amendment language (term + pricing).

Please find the pre-read here: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/73429 and I’ll circulate a DocuSign link for the SOW after we align.

See you shortly,
Dylan

Attachments: SOW-draft-BlueBay.docx

From: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Gomez <agomez@bluebaypharma.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>, BlueBay Procurement <procurement@bluebaypharma.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 17:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal + isolated enclave at renewal — timeline and ask

Alicia / Peter — following today’s call and the commitments Ben outlined, we’ve captured an amended-term proposal: 3-year renewal (auto-renew opt-out at month 30), one-time accelerated provisioning fee of $40k, and monthly committed capacity at $65k/month covering dedicated clusters in US + EU. Acceptance criteria:
- Staged acceptance: infra smoke test (day +3), secure KMS test (day +7), production switchover (day +21).
- Security deliverables: SOC2 report (latest), KMS integration runbook, and an audit log access plan.

I attached the redlined SOW for your review — if approved we’ll issue a DocuSign SOW and an addendum to the master agreement. Can procurement confirm the PO timeline?

Thanks,
Monica

Attachments: SOW-draft-BlueBay.docx (redline)
